verdicts.note: Pole_a is literally 'oversight, audits'. The position repeats across the pamphlet ('eliminate any possible waste, fraud and abuse') [S1], her Q&A ('taxpayer watchdog'; audit the 'entire financial apparatus' to 'root out waste') [S3], CCT [S9] and the LWV forum [S10]. Four sources and a central campaign plank: -2 high stands.

A score of 0 gives the 'fresh eyes' framing too much weight. Her pamphlet statement opens with 'proven experience ... and the ability to lead on day one' and closes 'ready to bring experienced professional leadership' [S1]. Her campaign Q&A runs an 'Experience Matters' series ('Not every government job requires experience- but this one absolutely does') [S3], and the Columbian quotes her citing her work with the auditor's office as council chair [S7]. 'Fresh eyes' appears once in the pamphlet, and the outsider language in S9 targets the office's administration, not her own profile. She sells a decade of elected office (Oregon Legislature, county council chair) as proven leadership, which is a record-side profile. She is not the office insider, so -1 rather than -2. Dossier gap: its experience notes cite only the 'fresh eyes' line and leave out this framing.
A ten-year office insider who argues the office 'should continue to be led by someone with the experience' [S2][S3], but who has never held elected office. -1 medium fits.
